Introduction

BE BOYS is a South Korean boy group under OAK COMPANY, consisting of 6 members: Goo Hyun, Min Joon, Yun Seo, Hak Seong, Takuma, and Won Cheon. The group was first introduced on April 18, 2025, and debuted on June 18 with their 1st mini album BE:1.
